title: Give OLY-B-SET-02 a model-roster mechanism and test
summary: Add a checked model roster (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku via configured roles, plus Jev via the Vercel AI Gateway constants in jev.rs) with a test that fails without it, then record it as the mechanism and measure for OLY-B-SET-02 in docs/spec.toml. Audience: Athena's owner and the spec gap check.

defaults_applied.how: New test plus fmt, clippy, test criterion
Criterion runs the roster test that fails without the mechanism
One roster module and one spec edit
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs (ENDPOINT, MODEL, KEY_VAR, shadow-only), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (status entry point), and model names in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs and run tests; no new record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are unaffected.
Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs and docs/spec.toml (other Jev requirements already use `athena score-jev`); the change extends jev.rs constants with a roster.
The measure is `status: not shown` plus the test, since no `athena status` line shows the roster.
Jev's existing shadow-only rule stays; the requirement is met by the roster existing, not by Jev deciding work.
Consumers: none found for config; athena.toml and defaults.toml are not changed.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-SET-02 has a mechanism other than "none" naming the roster code path and test, owner Athena, and a measure ending with `status: not shown` and the test command.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core` (the new roster test): it asserts the roster holds Opus, Sonnet and Haiku model names and Jev with the ai-gateway.vercel.sh endpoint; it fails when the roster entry for any of the four is removed and passes with the change.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` all pass; the xtask spec test (`cargo test -p xtask --test spec`) still passes with the edited spec.toml.
Existing Jev constants (ENDPOINT, MODEL in crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs) are reused, not duplicated; no secrets are written.

out_of_scope: Making Jev decide real work (it stays shadow-only)
